genres.name: VICTORIAN NEO-RIEMANNIAN TONNETZ
genres.description: Parsimonious P/L/R voice-leading across 4 harmonic regions with Euler G ≤ 8 consonance.

genres.name: 12-BAR DELTA & PARLOR BLUES
genres.description: Authentic I7-IV7-V7 12-bar chord matrix with walking shuffle bass and blue-note sieve.

genres.name: SMOKY PARLOR JAZZ & EXTENDED TONNETZ
genres.description: ii-V-I progressions with rootless 3rd/7th/9th guide tones, swung overtones, and chromatic approaches.

genres.name: PALESTRINA MODAL COUNTERPOINT
genres.description: 16th-century species counterpoint with prepared suspensions, stepwise motion, and strict G ≤ 5 consonance.

genres.name: MYSTIC BYZANTINE & HIMALAYAN DRONE
genres.description: Hypnotic root & fifth drone pedal with Phrygian dominant microtonal scale ladders and open chords.

genres.name: RAW ESOTERIC CHAOS (UNFETTERED VMS)
genres.description: Zero harmonic filtration. Raw, native, unquantized mathematical outputs from all six esoteric virtual machines.
